resources.string: Closes short-form video feeds as they open

ShortFormBlocker watches the screens of the apps you chose (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, browsers and so on) so it can tell when a Shorts or Reels feed opens, and immediately navigates away from it. Screen content is read on the device only: nothing is stored and nothing is sent anywhere.
Keeps short-form blocking alive and warns when it stops working
